chunks: ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad, from some of our companions, from Ayyūb ibn Nūḥ, from Abū al-Ḥasan al-Thālith عليه السلام, who said:
When your knowledge is raised from among you, then expect the relief from beneath your feet.

key_terms.أَظْهُرِكُمْ: your midst or your visible presence
key_terms.أَقْدَامِكُمْ: your feet, used here in the expression 'from beneath your feet'
key_terms.الْفَرَجَ: the relief, deliverance, or divine opening
key_terms.بَيْنِ: among or in the midst of
key_terms.عِلْمُكُمْ: your knowledge, especially divinely guided knowledge among the community

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith mean by the raising of knowledge and the coming of relief?
ai.summary: This hadith speaks of a time when access to divinely guided knowledge is removed from the people. In that state of loss and concealment, the believers are instructed to await the coming relief, indicating a promised divine opening after hardship.
